notes.title: Achievement Update - v2.2.3 Release
notes.content:
Hey All!!

The Achievement Update is here.  Based on the current player data, it was fairly obvious that the games original achievements were WAY too easy to unlock.  So, we've leveled the playing field.  Here's a quick breakdown of the entire update:

-  Added new achievements, bringing the total to 17 for those players looking for more of a challenge to "perfect" the game.


-  Added FULL controller support.  All screens and menus of the game can now be access using the controller.  This includes the Help screen, the Credits screen, as well as quitting the game.


-  Added a small change to allow the Nuclear Bears head to bounce off of the games "walls"


Hopefully this is a bit more of an added challenge for those of you who were asking for it.  Go forth and BeeFend!!!

- BWT Games

notes.title: Major Update! - 2.2.1
notes.content:
Hey all - BWT Games back at it again with another update.  This one is a big one, so make sure you're sitting down.  Here are the details:


- Fix a bug with a specific achievement that caused a fatal crash (Thanks Bee!)

- Clamped the bear to make sure the player cannot shoot the bear fully offscreen.  We were noticing that sometimes a player would kill a bear while it was offscreen  This fixes that issue and adds a slight degree of difficulty as a charging, vicious bear will always be that much closer.  Also, note that this also pertains to the bear head as well.

- Wipe all enemies at the explosion scene transition as well as added a smear of blood splatter to lightly change the mood and get the player ready for whats to come.


This next one is huge.  Probably the most profound game change since BeeFender has released, and it involves the most frustratingly-talked-about part of the game: the spider.  Many reviews have mentioned it.  Many YouTube videos have mentioned it.  No matter how you slice it - the spider was a major pain, and an absolute death warrant in late game.  So in our first attempt to balance out gameplay, we made the following changes:

- Created a mini-game to free the player from the spider web by shaking the player left and right.  This works on both keyboard-and-mouse setup using the 'A' and 'D' keys, as well as left and right on the left analog stick if you're using a controller.

To a degree, we expect this change to impact MOST players.  We'll be reviewing scores and looking at the numbers to see how this turns out.  As this is an entirely new gameplay mechanic, a new page has also been added to the Help section to describe it in further detail.

Lastly - as the game gains some user momentum, it's clear that we needed to rework the leaderboard.  You'll now notice that each user posts a SINGLE score to the board as opposed to submitting a separate score for each game they play.  We get it, Bee.  You're #1.  ːsteamhappyː  You don't have to keep reminding us that you're also #2, #3, #4, etc...




As always - keep the feedback coming!


BWT Games

notes.title: Update Has Dropped!
notes.content:
Hey All - we want to thank everyone for being patient.  We've listened to a lot of your feedback, and have implemented some fixes into the game.  Here's a breakdown of the update:

- Turned off linear interpolation.  The soft, fuzzy edges have been replaced by hard, jagged, pixelated greatness.  We think it makes for a much crisper experience.

- Reduced volume of all sounds/music by 20%

- Re-drew enemy sprites (birds, bugs) in an effort to maintain uniformity.

- Added a 1-second delay in enemy spawning after the use of a bomb.  Note that this only applies to birds.  Once the larvae in the ground start moving, theres no stopping them!

- Brightened the shade of purple on enemy birds.

- Added an element of randomness to the enemy bird movement to keep the player on their toes.

- Re-drew the player sprite in an effort to locate the player during later-game gore showers.

- Re-drew the spider sprite to include an thin, white outline.  Many players have mentioned that it's difficult to notice the spiders presence before it's too late.  Without adding a game-breaking hint, like a subtle sound effect, we thought this was the best way to make the spider "pop" off screen.  This small outline effect was also added to the player.


And with that, BeeFender is complete.  As soon as Steam allows us (Monday morning at 9pm, pacific time), we'll be release BeeFender from Early Access.  Thank you all so much, and enjoy!

- BWT Games

notes.title: Upcoming Update
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who has played or streamed BeeFender so far, and a huge thanks to anyone who has left a review or provided feedback that will further the development of the title.  We are aware of some issues that users are experiencing and plan to put out a fix ASAP to address some of the things that we see as the most urgent.  Note that there will be some delay before the fixes are released due to known issues in Game Maker Studio 2.  We are being careful not to update this with any potentially game-breaking issues. 

One thing that will be addressed in the next update is the game volume; this has been reported as an issue for several users.  Our best suggestion until the update is released is to simply check your volume settings and make sure that your volume is turned DOWN, preferrably to 3/4 or less of full volume, especially if you're wearing headphones.  

Lastly, just a quick reminder that the current contest for the high score is ending April 13th!  We've seen some impressive scores so far, but no one has beaten the beta battle score of 242,500, set by Zstan!

We're listening to all of the feedback we can to improve the game without straying from our original vision.  Keep it coming!  

- BWT Games

notes.title: Beta Update #2
notes.content:
Hey All - We're back at it again with another beta update!  The feedback continues to roll in, and we wanted to let everyone know that we've been listening.  This update includes:


- Tweaks to audio priorities to ensure sounds play properly.

- A reworking of the power-up random number generator to ensure the player experiences a more balanced feel each play-through.

- New particles for the Yellow and Blue power-ups because the last particles just didn't seem to fit the graphics style.  People did seem to enjoy the Grey power-ups particles, so these new ones are a variation of that.




Enjoy, and please keep the feedback coming!  March 12th is right around the corner.  Almost time to BEEFEND!!!


- BWT Games

notes.title: Beta Update #1
notes.content:
Hi all!  We've handed out a handful of beta keys, and the feedback we've been getting is unbelievable!  We decided to dive into the game and make a few updates.  This update includes:

- Adjustment to Spider random generation that stops Spider from appearing
while the player is still wrapped in her web from her previous appearance.

- New fonts for title screen, game screen, and leaderboard to replace development fonts.

- Gamepad compatibility.  Players can now control their bee by using the classic twin-stick shooter setup.  Left analog stick controls the player movement, while the right analog stick aims and shoots simultaneously.  The right trigger will drop the bombs the player picks up, while the left trigger will deploy the drones.


The Beta Battle continues!  So far, Zstan leads the competition with a score of 242,500!  We have 10 days left!  BeeFend!

(Manunkind2 and illbeinmyoffice are ineligible for the contest as they are developers of this title.)
